ruleDefinitions.name: Clfs.SYS Loaded By Process Located In a Potential Suspicious Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Clfs.sys being loaded by a process running from a potentially suspicious location. Clfs.sys is loaded as part of many CVEs exploits that targets Common Log File. Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\clfs\\\.sys$") AND ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) OR ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Favorites\\\\.*")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Favourites\\\\.*")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Contacts\\\\.*")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Pictures\\\\.*"))))
